svg.title: How to add a blip texture in GTA 3 using Magic.TXD
svg.desc: Step-by-step flowchart for importing a custom blip texture into GTA 3's radar atlas using Magic.TXD

g.onclick: sendPrompt('Where do I find the radar.txd file in GTA 3?')
g.text: Step 1 — locate radar.txd
GTA3/models/fronted3.txd or txd/radar.txd depending on version

g.onclick: sendPrompt('How do I open a TXD file in Magic.TXD?')
g.text: Step 2 — open the .txd in Magic.TXD
File → Open (or drag-and-drop the .txd onto the window)

g.onclick: sendPrompt('What image format should my blip texture be in for GTA 3?')
g.text: Step 3 — prepare your blip image
PNG or BMP, power-of-two size (e.g. 32×32 or 64×64)
Transparent background supported via alpha channel

g.onclick: sendPrompt('How do I import a texture into a TXD using Magic.TXD?')
g.text: Step 4 — import your texture
In the texture list panel → click "Add Texture" (+ icon)
Browse to your PNG/BMP and confirm

g.onclick: sendPrompt('What texture name should I give my blip in GTA 3?')
g.text: Step 5 — set the texture name
Double-click the texture entry → rename to match the blip ID
e.g. radar_blip (must match what the game / script references)

g.onclick: sendPrompt('What pixel format should blip textures use in GTA 3 TXD files?')
g.text: Step 6 — check pixel format & mipmaps
Format → DXT1 (no alpha) or DXT3/DXT5 (with alpha) for PS2/PC
Mipmaps: generate at least 1 level (Texture → Generate Mipmaps)

g.onclick: sendPrompt('How do I reference a custom blip texture in GTA 3 scripts?')
g.text: Step 7 — register in gta3.dat / scripts (if needed)
For custom blip IDs, reference the texture name in your SCM/CLEO script
Built-in blip slots (e.g. radar00–radar63) don't need extra registration

g.onclick: sendPrompt('How do I save a modified TXD in Magic.TXD?')
g.text: Step 8 — save the .txd
File → Save (overwrites) or Save As to keep a backup first

g.onclick: sendPrompt('How do I test a new blip texture in GTA 3?')
g.text: Step 9 — test in-game
Launch GTA 3, open the radar/minimap and verify your blip appears
If invisible: check name spelling, format, and that the file was saved

svg.text: Tip: always back up the original .txd before editing.
Click any step to ask a follow-up question ↗
